description: This file defines a PHP attribute class 'ReturnTypeWillChange' used for backward compatibility with PHP versions prior to 8.1. It provides a conditional class definition based on the PHP version.

classes.name: ReturnTypeWillChange
classes.description: An attribute class used to annotate methods when return types are expected to change in future PHP versions, mainly for compatibility purposes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for the ReturnTypeWillChange attribute class; it is an empty constructor.
